title: Rutaecarpine Attenuates Hepatic Lipid Accumulation and Oxidative Stress by Activating Autophagy Through the AMPK/ULK1 Pathway.
authors: Jin, Meiyu; Yu, Hao; Lv, Mengfan; Cheng, Jiaqi; Zhang, Yibo; Zhai, Yaxin; Feng, Haihua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物Rutaecarpine通过AMPK/ULK1通路激活自噬缓解肝脏脂质堆积，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a prevalent metabolic disorder disease in modern society, primarily caused by abnormal fat accumulation in the liver. This study aims to uncover the effects and potential mechanisms by which Rutaecarpine (Rut) alleviates lipid accumulation and oxidative damage in hepatocytes. Oleic acid and palmitic acid were used to induce lipid accumulation in AML12 cells, and Tyloxapol was used to induce hepatic lipid accumulation in mice. Then, various concentrations of Rut were administered. The mechanisms were further explored by using the Nrf2 inhibitor ML385, the AMPK inhibitor compound C (CC), and the autophagy inhibitor chloroquine. Additionally, computer simulations were employed to analyze the binding capacity of Rut to AMPK subunits. The study revealed that Rut significantly reduces lipid content and enhances the phosphorylation levels of AMPKalpha and Nrf2 expression. Crucially, the AMPK inhibitor CC markedly diminished Rut's antioxidant and lipid-lowering effects. The study also identified that Rut promotes non-canonical activation of Nrf2 protein by regulating autophagy-related processes, although this effect was inhibited by CC. Furthermore, computer simulations demonstrated that Rut has a strong binding affinity for AMPK subunits, indicating that Rut may promote AMPK activation through potential specific subunit interactions. In summary, Rut alleviates lipid accumulation and oxidative stress by promoting activation of the AMPK/ULK1 signaling pathway and autophagy, providing foundational theoretical and experimental support for its potential application in treating lipid metabolic disorders.
abstract_zh: 非酒精性脂肪肝病（NAFLD）是现代社会中常见的代谢性疾病，主要由肝脏内异常脂肪积累引起。本研究旨在揭示芦丁（Rut）缓解肝细胞脂质积累和氧化损伤的作用及其潜在机制。采用油酸和棕榈酸诱导AML12细胞脂质积累，并用Tyloxapol诱导小鼠肝脏脂质积累，随后给予不同浓度的Rut处理。通过使用Nrf2抑制剂ML385、AMPK抑制剂compound C（CC）和自噬抑制剂氯喹进一步探索其机制。此外，利用计算机模拟分析Rut与AMPK亚基的结合能力。研究发现，Rut显著降低脂质含量，并增强AMPKα的磷酸化水平及Nrf2的表达。关键的是，AMPK抑制剂CC显著削弱了Rut的抗氧化和降脂效果。研究还发现，Rut通过调节自噬相关过程促进Nrf2蛋白的非经典激活，尽管这一效应被CC抑制。此外，计算机模拟表明Rut对AMPK亚基具有强结合亲和力，提示Rut可能通过潜在的特异性亚基相互作用促进AMPK激活。总之，Rut通过促进AMPK/ULK1信号通路激活和自噬，缓解脂质积累和氧化应激，为其在治疗脂质代谢紊乱中的潜在应用提供了基础理论和实验支持。
